affiliate_events_nonnegative_check.name: affiliate_events_nonnegative_check
affiliate_events_nonnegative_check.value: "affiliate_events"."commission_basis_minor" >= 0 AND "affiliate_events"."gross_earned_minor" >= 0 AND "affiliate_events"."refund_clawback_minor" >= 0 AND "affiliate_events"."net_payable_minor" >= 0 AND ("affiliate_events"."commission_rate_bps" IS NULL OR ("affiliate_events"."commission_rate_bps" >= 0 AND "affiliate_events"."commission_rate_bps" <= 10000))

cohort_memberships_exclusion_reason_chec.name: cohort_memberships_exclusion_reason_check
cohort_memberships_exclusion_reason_chec.value: ("cohort_memberships"."eligibility_state" = 'eligible' AND "cohort_memberships"."exclusion_reason" IS NULL) OR ("cohort_memberships"."eligibility_state" = 'excluded' AND "cohort_memberships"."exclusion_reason" IS NOT NULL)

cost_events_state_check.name: cost_events_state_check
cost_events_state_check.value: "cost_events"."stream" IN ('software', 'affiliate', 'human_service') AND "cost_events"."category" IN ('source_data', 'rendering', 'model_stage_a', 'model_stage_b', 'adjudication', 'retry_validation', 'storage', 'egress', 'queue', 'email', 'push', 'sms', 'processor', 'dispute', 'support', 'correction_rework', 'trust_recovery', 'human_fulfillment', 'acquisition', 'other') AND "cost_events"."estimate_state" IN ('estimated', 'actual', 'reconciled') AND "cost_events"."cash_state" IN ('cash', 'noncash')

cost_events_shared_allocation_check.name: cost_events_shared_allocation_check
cost_events_shared_allocation_check.value: ("cost_events"."shared_object_ref" IS NULL AND "cost_events"."allocation_method" IS NULL AND "cost_events"."allocation_version" IS NULL AND "cost_events"."allocation_share_bps" IS NULL AND "cost_events"."shared_total_amount_micros" IS NULL) OR ("cost_events"."shared_object_ref" IS NOT NULL AND "cost_events"."allocation_method" IS NOT NULL AND "cost_events"."allocation_version" IS NOT NULL AND "cost_events"."allocation_share_bps" > 0 AND "cost_events"."allocation_share_bps" <= 10000 AND "cost_events"."shared_total_amount_micros" >= 0 AND "cost_events"."amount_micros" = CAST(("cost_events"."shared_total_amount_micros" * "cost_events"."allocation_share_bps") / 10000 AS INTEGER))

experience_role_merge_user_decision_chec.name: experience_role_merge_user_decision_check
experience_role_merge_user_decision_chec.value: ("experience_role_merge_proposals"."state" = 'proposed' AND "experience_role_merge_proposals"."decided_by_user_at" IS NULL) OR ("experience_role_merge_proposals"."state" <> 'proposed' AND "experience_role_merge_proposals"."decided_by_user_at" IS NOT NULL)

offer_versions_board_authority_check.name: offer_versions_board_authority_check
offer_versions_board_authority_check.value: ("offer_versions"."approval_state" NOT IN ('board_approved_private_test', 'active_private_test') OR ("offer_versions"."board_decision_ref" IS NOT NULL AND length(trim("offer_versions"."board_decision_ref")) > 0)) AND ("offer_versions"."approval_state" <> 'active_private_test' OR "offer_versions"."effective_at" IS NOT NULL)

offer_versions_cm_targets_check.name: offer_versions_cm_targets_check
offer_versions_cm_targets_check.value: ("offer_versions"."target_cm1_bps" IS NULL OR ("offer_versions"."target_cm1_bps" >= 0 AND "offer_versions"."target_cm1_bps" <= 10000)) AND ("offer_versions"."target_cm2_bps" IS NULL OR ("offer_versions"."target_cm2_bps" >= 0 AND "offer_versions"."target_cm2_bps" <= 10000))

orders_charges_nonnegative_amounts_check.name: orders_charges_nonnegative_amounts_check
orders_charges_nonnegative_amounts_check.value: "orders_charges"."gross_amount_minor" >= 0 AND "orders_charges"."discount_amount_minor" >= 0 AND "orders_charges"."tax_amount_minor" >= 0 AND "orders_charges"."cash_collected_minor" >= 0 AND "orders_charges"."processor_fee_micros" >= 0 AND "orders_charges"."refund_amount_minor" >= 0 AND "orders_charges"."credit_amount_minor" >= 0 AND "orders_charges"."chargeback_amount_minor" >= 0

resume_assignments_exact_scope_check.name: resume_assignments_exact_scope_check
resume_assignments_exact_scope_check.value: ("resume_assignments"."scope" = 'default' AND "resume_assignments"."career_path_id" IS NULL AND "resume_assignments"."job_posting_id" IS NULL) OR ("resume_assignments"."scope" = 'path' AND "resume_assignments"."career_path_id" IS NOT NULL AND "resume_assignments"."job_posting_id" IS NULL) OR ("resume_assignments"."scope" = 'job' AND "resume_assignments"."career_path_id" IS NULL AND "resume_assignments"."job_posting_id" IS NOT NULL)

usage_events_cost_event_user_check.name: usage_events_cost_event_user_check
usage_events_cost_event_user_check.value: "usage_events"."cost_event_id" IS NULL OR "usage_events"."user_id" IS NOT NULL
